text_block_list.text:
During training one day. I felt a gaze and 
looked up to see…

The person looking at me was someone I 
didn't recognize. I assumed it was a fan 
or a visitor.

At the end of training, she was still 
looking at me. … Is there something she 
wants to talk about?

Ah… I'm sorry. I hope I didn't interrupt 
your practice.

I'm glad to hear that! Actually, there is 
something I would like to talk to you 
about.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
I'm Etsuko Otonashi, a reporter for 
"Twinkle Monthly".

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
… I watched your training and was greatly 
impressed. I would love to support you 
both with articles. I have been waiting to 
discuss this with you.

She seems polite and sincere. With her 
considered articles, she may be able to 
gain <chrname> some fans.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your willingness. So, let's 
get right to it… What do you consider when 
deciding on a training plan?

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: … I see. So your role as a trainer is to—
choice_data_list:
It's to help my Uma Musume achieve her 
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you're prepared to do 
whatever it takes to make sure that the 
horse girl in your charge reaches her 
dream!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
When she trains you train with her, when 
she's tired you provide hot springs, when 
she's thirsty you would scoop water from 
mountains!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Ahh… I'm floored… with your determination 
as trainer. I'll turn this into an article 
that will blow their minds…!

This is how I came to know a — in many 
ways— powerful supporter…!
